# Library Used

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(vars)
library(tseries)
library(conflicted)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

```

# Data
## Import
```{r}
CMO_AnnualPrice <- read_csv("../data/raw/CMO-AnnualPrice.csv")
CMO_AnnualPrice_Real <- read_csv("../data/raw/CMO-AnnualPriceReal.csv")

```

## Data Cleaning
```{r}
CMO_AnnualPrice <- CMO_AnnualPrice[-c(67:77), ] # dropping the empty rows

cmo_clean <- CMO_AnnualPrice_Real %>%
  select(-starts_with("...")) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(., "…"))) %>%
  mutate(across(-Year, as.numeric)) %>%
  clean_names()

```

## Time Series Data
```{r}
model_data <- cmo_clean %>%
  select(year, crude_oil_average, urea, rice_thai_5_percent) %>%
  drop_na()

ts_data <- ts(model_data[, c("crude_oil_average", "urea", "rice_thai_5_percent")], 
              start = min(model_data$year), 
              frequency = 1)

```

# Analysis
## VAR Model
```{r}
var_model <- vars::VAR(ts_data, p = 2, type = "both")
summary(var_model)
```

## 10-Year Forecast
```{r}
forecast_10yr <- predict(var_model, n.ahead = 10, ci = 0.95)

plot(forecast_10yr, 
     names = "rice_thai_5_percent", 
     main = "10-Year Forecast: Benchmark SEA Rice Prices",
     xlab = "Year", 
     ylab = "Real Price ($/mt)")
```

## Impulse Response Function (IRF)
```{r}
irf_model <- irf(var_model, 
                 impulse = "urea", 
                 response = "rice_thai_5_percent", 
                 n.ahead = 10, 
                 boot = TRUE)

irf_df <- data.frame(
  year_after_shock = 0:10,
  estimate = as.numeric(irf_model$irf$urea),
  lower_ci = as.numeric(irf_model$Lower$urea),
  upper_ci = as.numeric(irf_model$Upper$urea)
)

# Build the custom ggplot
ggplot(irf_df, aes(x = year_after_shock, y = estimate)) +
  # Add the baseline (zero impact)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  # Add the confidence interval ribbon (shaded area)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_ci, ymax = upper_ci), fill = "#D95F02", alpha = 0.2) +
  # Add the main estimate line
  geom_line(color = "#D95F02", size = 1.2) +
  # Add data points on the line
  geom_point(color = "#D95F02", size = 3) +
  # Professional aesthetic styling
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 20)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Macroeconomic Shock: Impact of Fertilizer Costs on Mekong Rice",
    subtitle = "Impulse Response Function (VAR Model): Response to a systemic Urea price spike",
    x = "Years Following the Initial Shock",
    y = "Change in Rice Price ($/mt)",
    caption = "Proxy applied for Cambodian Rice Markets | 95% Bootstrap CI"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2))

```
